verdict.rationale: Cal.com's API docs distinguish test-mode secret keys (prefix `cal_`) from live-mode keys (prefix `cal_live_`), which points to a first-party test mode separate from production. However, this rests on a single line, and nothing describes how test mode isolates data or behaves for bookings, webhooks or payments. Self-hosting Cal.diy as a sandbox would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of what test mode isolates (data, bookings, payments, webhooks), a dedicated sandbox environment or base URL, test-mode support in the MCP server or CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
